original_title: Provision of General Medical Services at Tollgate Practice
english_summary: NHS Essex Integrated Care Board is seeking a qualified provider to deliver General Medical Services to approximately 10,206 registered patients at Tollgate Practice in Stanway, Colchester under a perpetual GMS contract valued at approximately £21.9 million over a notional 20-year period.

original_title: Contract Notice

original_title: Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS)
buyer_name: North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust
english_summary: North Staffordshire Combined Healthcare NHS Trust is reopening a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) covering North Staffordshire and Stoke on Trent. what_they_want: Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS) for the 0-25 year age spectrum (primarily 0-18 years). eligibility_requirements: Suitably experienced organisations with expertise in Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services. Applicants must indicate their area(s) of expertise and delivery modalities as part of the qualification process, which will form the basis for shortlisting in future procurements.
